title: The free module sheaf on a presheaf of sets depends only on its sheafification
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $R$ a commutative ring. For a presheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $\mathcal C$ let $R[\mathcal F]$ be the presheaf of $R$-modules $V\mapsto R[\mathcal F(V)]$, the free $R$-module on the set $\mathcal F(V)$, with restriction maps the $R$-linear extensions of those of $\mathcal F$, and let $R[\mathcal F]^\#$ be its sheafification as a presheaf of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]; a morphism $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ of presheaves of sets induces $R[\varphi]:R[\mathcal F]\to R[\mathcal G]$ and $R[\varphi]^\#:R[\mathcal F]^\#\to R[\mathcal G]^\#$. If the sheafification $\varphi^\#:\mathcal F^\#\to\mathcal G^\#$ of $\varphi$ as a morphism of presheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] is an isomorphism, then $R[\varphi]^\#$ is an isomorphism of sheaves of $R$-modules.
